hooks.name: actionlint on workflow save
hooks.description: Run actionlint on any saved GitHub Actions workflow file and report errors.

action.command:
FILE=$(echo "$KIRO_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('path',''))" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$FILE" ] && command -v actionlint &>/dev/null; then
  actionlint "$FILE" 2>&1 && echo "✓ actionlint OK: $FILE" || echo "❌ actionlint errors above — fix before committing"
fi
